verdict.rationale: Milvus is documented as an open-source vector database. Milvus Lite is a pip-installable library 'ideal for quick prototyping' that runs locally from a single file. It shares the same API as Standalone and Distributed, so a developer can prototype at no cost and scale later without code changes. Community users report it was quick to implement. missing for 10: no evidence of a hosted/managed free tier or its limits, no explicit license or pricing-page documentation confirming the open-source version stays free for production use.
